gloss: right to vote; voting rights; suffrage

definitions.gloss: right to vote; voting rights; suffrage
definitions.explanation: The legal right to cast a vote in an election. In Japan it is granted to citizens aged 18 and over.

examples.japanese: {投票権|とうひょうけん}を{得|え}る。
examples.english: I gain the right to vote.

examples.japanese: {十八|じゅうはっ}{歳|さい}から{投票権|とうひょうけん}がある。
examples.english: You have the right to vote from age eighteen.

examples.japanese: {投票権|とうひょうけん}は{民主主義|みんしゅしゅぎ}を{支|ささ}える{大切|たいせつ}な{権利|けんり}だ。
examples.english: The right to vote is an important right that supports democracy.

notes:
Compound of {投票|とうひょう} (voting) + {権|けん} (right). The 〜{権|けん} suffix forms many "right to ~" words.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {投票権|とうひょうけん}がある: to have the right to vote
- {投票権|とうひょうけん}を{行使|こうし}する: to exercise one's vote

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {選挙権|せんきょけん}: the right to vote in elections — the formal legal term
- {被選挙権|ひせんきょけん}: the right to be elected (to run for office)
